pdf_title_observed: Divide, Discover, Deploy: Factorized Skill Learning with Symmetry and Style Priors

figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2: Proposed algorithm for skill discovery. The agent πθ, conditioned on a sampled skill z and factor
weights λ, collects transitions and receives a total reward combining per-factor intrinsic rewards and a style
reward. The transitions are then augmented via symmetry-based mirroring, after which the intrinsic reward
models, factorized value functions, and policy are updated using on-policy RL.
figure_candidates.notes: Left architecture training loop and right Algorithm1 are one composite figure; retain both. Native text and vector arrows/shapes preserve equations and symmetry-augmentation feedback.
